description: Discover registered agents. Returns 20 compact rows {agent_id, name, capabilities, description} per call plus `count` (the total) — the whole directory is over a megabyte, so narrow it with `capability` or `q`, or page with `offset`. To find one agent or anything else by words, use search.

capability.description: Filter agents that have a specific capability

full.description: true = whole agent records. Default false: compact rows.

limit.description: rows to return (default 20, max 200; 0 = every match)

q.description: only agents whose id, name or description contains this text

name: list_agents
title: List agents
